decisions.reason: As a close-to-core candle-arch line it likely remains above aspiration levels overall, though its sound feature and weaker later visibility raise a moderate chance of assortment pruning.

This one-tier Christmas pyramid fits the firm's strongest traditional capabilities and is therefore likely still judged satisfactory relative to aspirations, with only limited risk of model replacement.

The Dresden-themed pyramid builds on established pyramid craftsmanship and should still benefit from the firm's core market, but its more specific motif makes it somewhat more vulnerable to rotation if results soften.
